Supplementary Material S1: Definitions, Calculations, and Complete Numerical Tables Color-Reconnection Effects on the nMPI–Nch Conditional Multiplicity Fluctuations in PYTHIA 8 pp Collisions Subir Sarkar and Kalyan Dey 21 October 2026 Resubmission note (21 October 2026). The approximate third configuration has been replaced by fresh CMS CP5 samples using the full-precision CMS tune card and the external NNPDF3.1 NNLO central PDF. All affected fluctuation profiles, matched-bin checks and estimator coefficients have been recalculated from five million events per CR state. Production-time settings, particle data and seeds are retained in cp5_exact/. The historical production-time seed and effective lifetime/decay records were not retained; exact historical replay is unavailable. The present resubmission draft adds checked integer joint-count inputs, a common conditional-width convention and complete matched-bin statistical uncertainties. The production-provenance limits are stated explicitly below. Abstract This standalone supplement records the analysis definitions, calculation sequence, statistical estimators, uncertainty propagation, selection checks, tune comparisons, and numerical tables underlying manuscript NPB-D-26-01492R2. It is intended to make explicit details that cannot be retained in the journal article because of space and presentation constraints. It does not introduce a separate physics claim; the interpretation and limitations are the same as in the revised manuscript.
